description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for an HTTP proxy, including methods to retrieve proxy parameters and convert settings to an Akka HTTP client transport. It also contains an enumeration for configuration path expressions and default values.

classes.name: HttpProxyConfig
classes.description: Interface providing HTTP proxy configuration accessors and a method to generate a client transport object.

classes.name: HttpProxyConfig.HttpProxyConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration defining configuration keys and default values for the HTTP proxy settings.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the HTTP proxy is enabled.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the HTTP proxy.

methods.name: toClientTransport
methods.description: Converts current proxy configuration into an Akka HTTP ClientTransport object.
